name: A Hero on Path of Duality gains attack power from its higher of Strength and Agility, Intellect, spell power and crit
contract: Path of Duality 129243 links Path of Duality: Stat Buff 820054: "Spell Power gained from items and effects is increased by 75%. Your attack power is increased by your Strength or Agility, whichever is highest." Effect 0 is Ascension's flat attack power aura 344 at level / 2 points and effect 2 a dummy, so the core supplies both: melee and ranged attack power rise by the higher stat and follow it, and spell power from items is multiplied by 1.75. A Hero has no other stat term in its attack power, so without the path its attack power does not move with Strength. The realm's design fills the empty effect 1 with 4 + level / 2 Intellect, adds 30% of Intellect as spell power after the 1.75, and makes melee, ranged and spell crit each use the higher of Agility and Intellect. Both per-level amounts follow a level-up without a relog. Coppercloth Gloves 4767 carry 4 spell power; a level-10 Human Hero has 25 Agility and 25 Intellect, about 10.3 Agility per 1% melee crit and 10.2 Intellect per 1% spell crit.
